$comment: All controlled vocabularies for the Chhelebela Score data layer, per SRS OD-04. Application code must validate against these lists; content edits happen here and in memories.json, never inside UI components (SRS NFR-009). 'legacy_mappings' documents exactly how the original spreadsheet vocabulary was normalized — no silent reclassification.

era_scope.description: Derived: 'multi' when era_tags has more than one entry. Neutral items would use era_tags ["neutral"].

classification_confidence.description: How confident the content team is in the current era_tags. Nothing is 'verified' yet — every spreadsheet row was 'Under review'.

setting_tags.description: Per SRS 6.6. 'unknown' is a temporary value marking rows that still need setting research (FLG-DS-06); it is NOT approved for launch.

validation_status.description: Per SRS 9.1. Only 'verified' items may ship in the launch list (SRS 6.8).

response_states.description: Per SRS 9.2. Whether 'unsure' is offered in the UI is the OD-01 scoring decision.

category_2026_11_14_batch.$comment: Raw spreadsheet category values (lowercased) → controlled ids. Synonyms merged; genuinely new concepts added as new categories pending OD-04 (FLG-DS-17).

setting_2026_11_14_batch.$comment: The batch used the setting column for locations/access ('Rooftop', 'Gulistan, Dhaka', 'TV access'). Rule: both/both* → both; unknown/blank → unknown; contains 'urban' or 'dhaka' → urban; starts with 'rural' → rural; everything else → context_specific. Raw preserved in item.source_setting (FLG-DS-18).

era_role.Overlapping: era_tags may span eras → era_scope 'multi' where more than one tag exists; classification_confidence 'probable' (overlap is evidence-backed but unverified)
era_role.conflicts: MEM_013, MEM_019, MEM_020, MEM_021 had era_role 'Overlapping' with a single era tag; kept as-is and flagged rather than guessing extra tags — see their flags.

setting.Both*: both (asterisk footnote preserved in review_notes_bn — MEM_001)
